input.quote: 22.1 Vendor may audit Customer at any time without notice and may remotely access Customer's systems and records for that purpose.
input.rationale: § 22.1 grants unlimited, unannounced audits with remote access to our systems — walk-away territory under the rule and a direct contradiction of § 22.2, which already bars direct system access and allocates audit costs to Vendor unless underpayment exceeds five percent. It fails the fallback on frequency and notice (no frequency limit, no notice at all). We replaced the offending sentence in § 22.1 with the preferred frequency, notice, business-hours, off-site and independent confidentiality-bound auditor limits, and deleted the remote-access grant; the protective cost allocation (5%) and no-direct-access language in § 22.2 are left verbatim.

mappings.element: Vendor may audit no more than once in any 12-month period.
Vendor must give at least 30 days' written notice of an audit.
Audits are conducted by an independent auditor.
The auditor is bound by confidentiality obligations.
Audits are conducted off-site where possible.
Vendor bears audit costs unless underpayment exceeds 5 percent.
mappings.quote: Vendor bears audit costs unless the audit establishes an underpayment exceeding five percent for the audited period

mappings.element: Vendor has no direct access to Customer systems for an audit.
mappings.quote: Vendor and its auditor may not access Customer systems directly

proposal.summary: Limit Vendor audits to once per 12 months on 30 days' written notice, in business hours, off-site where possible, by a confidentiality-bound independent auditor, and remove remote system access.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept audits at any time without notice or remote access to our systems, which also contradicts § 22.2. We have limited audits to once per 12 months on 30 days' written notice, during business hours, off-site where possible and by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality; the existing cost allocation and no-direct-access protections in § 22.2 are unchanged.

ops.oldText: 22.1 Vendor may audit Customer at any time without notice and may remotely access Customer's systems and records for that purpose.
ops.newText: 22.1 Vendor may audit Customer not more than once per 12 months, on 30 days' written notice, during business hours, off-site where possible, by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality obligations.
